documents.text:
Impact and Use Policy — Automatic License Plate Readers. Published under the Public Oversight of Surveillance Technology (POST) Act, a policy of the New York City Council.

Section 4 Data retention policies
The surveillance technology data retention policies provide the retention period for data collected through the technology and the rules regulating that retention.

Section 6 External entity access
External entity access to surveillance technologies data is described, including the rules regulating whether and how external entities may obtain access.

Section 8 Audit and oversight
The Department's internal audit and oversight mechanisms for the technology are described, including the offices responsible for audit coverage.

Section 10 Disparate impacts
The policy reports the potential disparate impacts of the surveillance technology on protected groups, per the POST Act reporting requirement.
